# anthropic_users (Data Source)

Lists members of the Anthropic organization (`GET /v1/organizations/users`), with optional filtering by `email`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Optional email filter.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) List of organization members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `added_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the user joined the organization.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the user.
- `name` (String) Display name of the user.
- `role` (String) Organization-level role of the user.
- `type` (String) Object type (`user`).
